question.text: If \(A\) and \(B\) are coefficients of \(x^{\mathrm{n}}\) in the expansions of \((1+x)^{2 \mathrm{n}}\) and \((1+x)^{2 \mathrm{n}-1}\) respectively, then \(\mathrm{A} / \mathrm{B}\) is equal to

solution.text:
\(\begin{array}{r}\text {Hints: } 
A={ }^{2 n} C_n \\
B={ }^{2 n-1} C_n
\end{array}\)
\(\frac{\mathrm{A}}{\mathrm{B}}=\frac{{ }^{2 \mathrm{n}} \mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{n}}}{{ }^{2 \mathrm{n}-1} \mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{n}}}=\frac{2 \mathrm{n}}{\mathrm{n}}=2\)
